senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; שגר) [that which is cast,] birth, foetus, premature birth.
units: Bekh. 3ᵃ (ref. to Ex. XIII, 12) פטר שגר בהמה ש׳ בהמה Rashi Var. ‘the first cast of an animal’, even the premature first birth of an animal is sacred; (ed. שֶׁגָּר בבהמה that which dwells in an animal).—2) run, flight (of a dove).
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 2:5">B. Bath. II, 5</cite> <he>מלא ש׳ היונה</he> a far as the dove flies (for food).
